title: Desk permission vocabulary v0
description: Every primitive a plugin or agent can reach, and the scope each one is limited to. Everything not granted is denied.

Permission.description: One permission with its scope. Plugin manifests declare these; bridge calls carry the one that covers them.

SearchReadPermission.description: Search explicitly published plugin documents and installed plugin launchers.

SearchSystemPermission.description: Query the OS file and application index and open a recent result with its default application.

FsReadPermission.description: Read files, list folders and watch for changes under the given paths.

FsWritePermission.description: Create, overwrite and delete files under the given paths.

ProcSpawnPermission.description: Start, write to and stop the listed programs, optionally in a PTY.

commands.description: Program names or absolute paths, without arguments.

pty.description: Whether the programs may run in a pseudo-terminal.

NetFetchPermission.description: Make HTTP(S) requests to the listed hosts.

AudioCapturePermission.description: Capture microphone audio, and optionally listen for the wake word.

wakeWord.description: Whether wake-word events may be delivered.

UiSurfacePermission.description: Open and close the surfaces the plugin manifest declares.

PluginManagePermission.description: List installed plugins, turn them on and off, and receive plugin.changed events.

BrainConversePermission.description: Talk to the brain in the desk's session with brain.say, and receive brain.turn events.

CmdInvokePermission.description: Invoke and list the commands whose ids the patterns cover, whoever provides them.

ids.description: Command id patterns the permission covers.

CmdAdvisePermission.description: Hook into or override commands other callers provide. Reserved for command hooks: no v0 method uses it yet.

SettingsReadPermission.description: Read other callers' settings that the patterns cover, and receive their settings.changed events.

LogReadPermission.description: Read every log channel with log.tail, and receive log.entry events.

EventsSubscribePermission.description: Subscribe with events.subscribe to the named core events about every caller.

PermManagePermission.description: See and revoke every caller's grants, and act as the prompter: receive perm.prompt events and answer them with perm.answer.

DataReadPermission.description: Read the items of the desk's index (data.*) that the kinds and sources cover. Absent kinds or sources mean all of them. There is no data:write: changes go through the connectors' commands.

sources.description: Connector id patterns the permission covers.

ConnectorManagePermission.description: List the connector instances with their status, connect and disconnect them, pause them and sync them (connector.*).

ViewManagePermission.description: List, open, save and remove the person's views (view.*).

ShellOpenPermission.description: Hand links to the system with shell.open: open URLs whose scheme is in schemes in their default app, and show files under paths in the file manager. Only http, https and mailto are ever opened, and a path is only shown, never opened or run.

paths.description: Path patterns whose files and folders the permission shows in the file manager.

UpdateManagePermission.description: See and drive the desk's own updates with update.*: the status, a check, a download, and applying a staged build, which restarts the desk. Receive update.changed. The desk grants it to the runtime and the CLI only; applying stays with the person.

ThemeManagePermission.description: Keep the person's own themes with theme.*: save a theme into the desk's user themes folder, import a .desk-theme bundle, export any installed theme as one, and remove a user theme. The desk grants it to the runtime and the CLI only.

ShellScheme.description: A URL scheme shell.open hands to the system: the browser for http and https, the mail app for mailto.

PathPattern.description: An absolute path, or one rooted at ~ or at ${plugin}, ${workspace} or ${home}, with forward slashes. * matches within a segment and ** across segments.

HostPattern.description: A host name, optionally with a port, or *. followed by a domain to cover its subdomains.

Command.description: A program name looked up on PATH, or an absolute path. No arguments and no whitespace.

CommandPattern.description: A command id, or a pattern in which * matches any run of characters, dots included: * covers every command, eris.* every command under eris.

ConnectorPattern.description: A connector's plugin id, or a pattern in which * matches any run of characters, dots included, like command ids: * covers every connector, endue.* every connector under endue.

SettingPattern.description: owner/key: a caller id and a setting key, where * matches any run of characters within its part. endue.eris/voice is one setting; endue.eris/* covers every Eris setting.

EventName.description: A core event that events.subscribe can ask for.
